<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

On 2026-10-17 pij allocated the seat id pij-gay-thorn. Jordan: "we need to stay well clear of anything that might be subjectively examined". Seat ids are adjective-noun pairs (or a ship name) from a curated corpus vendored twice: crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs and .omp/extensions/pij/core/name-corpus.ts, with an EXCLUDED_NAME_WORDS list that is too narrow. Other ids seen this month: pij-controversial-guanaco, pij-crooked-thunderbluff, pij-additional-leeroy, pij-irregular-apocalypse; the ship list includes xenophobe, zealot, shoot-them-later, killing-time and jack-ketch. This plan sweeps every word conservatively and removes the risky ones in both runtimes.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- No allocated seat id can be read as offensive, sensitive, judgemental, or as using someone else's trademark or character.
- The two runtimes keep producing identical ids.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Renaming or closing existing seats (Jordan decides from assets/live-seats.md).
- Changing the id format, hashing or allocation algorithm.
- Adding new words to replace removed ones.

The bar is Jordan's: stay well clear of anything that might be subjectively examined. When in doubt, remove.
